summary: Completed targeted backend+frontend verification for admin in-app notification P0 scope: /api/notifications/admin/log permissions/scope/filters/projection, sticky header bell placement, sidebar/drawer bell removal, and /admin/notifications behavior across super admin and support admin on desktop/mobile.

issues: Minor but reproducible horizontal overflow likely caused by combined filter/grid width constraints

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow on /admin/notifications at 390px (ensure total layout width <= viewport, especially filter row/grid and input/select controls).
Re-run mobile notification page regression after overflow fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint /api/notifications/admin/log correctly enforces notifications.view and super-admin-only scope=all behavior, while preserving response projection without MongoDB _id fields.

Frontend route protection and navigation visibility for notifications.view are working: restricted custom admin (without notifications.view) cannot see menu and is redirected away from /admin/notifications.
Notification bell implementation is correctly mounted in sticky top header and absent from admin sidebar/drawer in tested views.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all targeted functional flows passed; 1 confirmed mobile overflow defect)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary custom admin role/user without notifications.view during UI route-protection verification; cleaned up within test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file for this scope is /app/backend/tests/test_iter60_admin_notifications_log.py and passed fully. UI validated on public URL with superadmin/support accounts. Confirmed: bell sticky in header, not present in sidebar/drawer; history link works; super admin sees scope tabs, support does not; restricted custom admin redirected from /admin/notifications. Remaining defect: 390px overflow on /admin/notifications.
rca of the issue: RCA (frontend): /admin/notifications uses dense filter layout and control widths that exceed narrow viewport by ~2px under 390px width. Reproduction: login admin -> open /admin/notifications on 390x844 -> evaluate documentElement.scrollWidth (392) vs innerWidth (390), overflow true. Mitigation: constrain container/control widths and prevent min-content expansion in filter grid row.
